landmarks.label: Coit Tower

height_reference.title: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Coit Tower brochure
height_reference.note: The department brochure reports 212 feet; other references report 210. This model explicitly follows the brochure rather than silently mixing height references.

landmarks.source_note: Original approximate fluted tower and observation arcade above its observed DataSF base footprint. Overall height follows the Recreation and Parks brochure. Shaft radius, tower center within the footprint, arch details and facade proportions are illustrative, not a surveyed architectural model.

landmarks.label: Sutro Tower

height_reference.title: Sutro Tower operator: About the Tower

landmarks.source_note: Original illustrative three-legged open-truss structure aligned to the observed DataSF tower footprint group. Overall height follows the tower operator. Leg widths, taper, bracing, platforms, antennas and red/white pattern are approximations, not current antenna inventories or structural engineering data. Three identified overlapping source tower parts are replaced visually; nearby service buildings remain.
